source_note: ISACA publishes the outline TWICE, and the two renderings differ. This file follows the web page in `source` (the short form). The Certification Exam Candidate Guide, Appendix A ('CISA Examination Content Outline (Effective August 2024)'), carries expanded strings for fourteen topics - ten are acronym expansions or capitalisation, but four add words: 1A1 adds 'Functions,'; 1B4 adds '(including audit algorithms)'; 5A1 adds 'Policies,'; 5B4 adds 'Logs,'. Both documents are live and both describe the same August 2024 job practice; neither supersedes the other. Recorded because a future re-verification against the Guide instead of the page would look like drift and is not. If the tagged strings are ever switched to the Guide's, every question tag has to move with them - `validate` enforces exact matches.
